data_fusion.architecture:
TremorClassificationCNN(
  (activity_embed): Embedding(12, 16)
  (features): Sequential(
    (0): Conv1d(6, 128, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
    (1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
    (2): ReLU()
    (3): MaxPool1d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)
    (4): Dropout(p=0.4, inplace=False)
    (5): Conv1d(128, 256, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
    (6): BatchNorm1d(256, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
    (7): ReLU()
    (8): MaxPool1d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)
    (9): Dropout(p=0.4, inplace=False)
  )
  (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
  (fc_embed): Linear(in_features=6416, out_features=128, bias=True)
  (drop_cls): Dropout(p=0.5, inplace=False)
  (fc_cls): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=5, bias=True)
)

feature_fusion_tremorEmb_mixedSet.architecture:
FeatureFusionClassifier(
  (classifier): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): ReLU()
    (2): Dropout(p=0.3, inplace=False)
    (3): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
    (4): ReLU()
    (5): Dropout(p=0.3, inplace=False)
    (6): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=5, bias=True)
  )
)
